name: Square Payroll
summary: Square Payroll costs $35 a month plus $6 per person paid for full-service payroll, or $6 per person a month for contractor-only payroll. It files federal and state payroll taxes, and says there are no long-term contracts. Workers comp, health insurance and 401(k) are add-ons with prices not shown on the pricing page.

facts.text: Square says payroll must be processed by 8 p.m. PT for employees to receive direct deposit on payday.
Timecards from Square POS or the Square Team App can be imported straight into payroll.
Square Payroll for Contractors generates, prepares and files Form 1099-NEC online.
Health insurance comes through partner SimplyInsured and 401(k) plans through partner Vestwell.

plans.name: Full-service payroll
plans.notes: Includes federal and state tax filings and year-end W-2 and 1099-NEC filings

hiddenCosts: Mailed paper W-2s and 1099s cost an annual $3 per mailed form; digital delivery is included.
Workers comp, paid amendment services, health insurance and 401(k) are add-ons, and the pricing page shows no prices for them.

contract.cancellation: The product page says there is no commitment, cancel anytime, and no long-term contracts.
